text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a quiet-window deploy tonight at 22:00 UTC (end-of-sprint). Pushing mobile-telemetry v2 + small routing tweak. Expected users: low.

aj: ack. who is primary for rollout and rollback? :raising_hand:

maria: devon is primary for the deploy, sasha is standby for rollback, kevin will run smoke checks/metrics. qa-runner will kick off the smoke test. ops-bot will post a reminder 10m before.

devon: I can take the rollout. Will do canary on 5% for 10m, then 25% for 15m, then full. Rollback criteria below.

sasha: I'll be on-call for rollback. If canary error rate > 1.5% OR 95th latency > 300ms for 3 consecutive minutes, we roll back. Also any data-integrity alerts from the ETL pipeline -> immediate rollback.

kevin: Confirming smoke checklist I'll run:
- basic e2e (login/send-event) x3
- ingestion metric increase/duplicate check
- dashboard sanity (error-rate, latency, throughput)
- feature flag verification (ff:mobile_telemetry_v2 off -> baseline)

qa-runner: I'll run the smoke automations after canary:
```
# smoke script snippet
python smoke/run_smoke.py --env=staging --samples=3 --verbose
```
I'll post results here and link to the raw logs.

maria: Rollback play (condensed):
1) set feature flag `mobile_telemetry_v2` to OFF (FF service)
2) revert canary route in gateway: `kubectl patch svc gateway -p '...'` (devon)
3) scale new service down: `k scale deployment/mobile-telemetry-v2 --replicas=0`
4) re-deploy previous image if needed: `k rollout undo deploy/mobile-telemetry`
5) notify #incidents and run postmortem template.

devon: I added the full step-by-step into the runbook section: https://redwood-infra.internal/runbooks/deploys/mobile-telemetry-v2 (see rollback section). I'll paste critical commands to this thread when I start.

aj: small question — are there any DB migrations?

maria: No schema migrations. We do a per-request header change; compatible with old format. No backfill.

kevin: Monitoring thresholds for auto-alerts are:
- error-rate > 1.5% on service:mobile-telemetry for 5m
- p95 latency > 350ms for 5m
- ingestion drop > 20% vs baseline 10m rolling
If any fires, page on-call and post here.

sasha: Who will have the final go/no-go at the 25% step?

devon: I'll call go/no-go after reviewing metrics and smoke logs. If any borderline metric or unexpected logs, we hold and consult.

maria: Quick checklist before 22:00: everyone react with :thumbsup: when ready. If you have concerns, reply now.

aj: :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:

sasha: :thumbsup: (I'll be nearby)

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Deploy for mobile-telemetry-v2 starting in 10 minutes (22:00 UTC). Assigned: devon (owner), sasha (rollback), kevin (smoke).

maria: Thanks. We'll keep this thread as the canonical deploy log. Post canary metrics + smoke results here. If rollback happens, note timestamp and trigger that matches runbook steps.

qa-runner: Will post automation output here after canary. ``logs: https://logs.internal/streams/abc123``

devon: Starting canary at 22:00 UTC. Will post each phase with timestamp.

kevin: Ready to watch dashboards (link: https://dashboards.internal/d/mobile-telemetry).

maria: Go team — see you on the other side. :rocket:
